:::{#exm-biconditional-split}
#### Proving an "if and only if" in two parts
<!-- no-figure: two short conditionals; nothing to plot -->

Let $n$ be an [integer](number-systems.qmd#def-integers).
By [a biconditional is two conditionals](#thm-biconditional-split),
to prove "$n$ is [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd) [if and only if](#def-iff) $n + 2$ is even",
it is enough to prove both conditionals:

- If $n = 2m$,
  then $n + 2 = 2(m + 1)$,
  which is even.
- If $n + 2 = 2m$,
  then $n = 2(m - 1)$,
  which is even.

:::
